endorsements.name: Eric Robi
endorsements.label: Forensic Fails - Shift + Delete won't help you here
endorsements.description: Forensic fails illustrates the rather comedic attempts at "anti-forensics" by inept computer users trying to hide their tracks. We will recount real-life stories about folks whose level of hacker-mojo might aspire to 1337 status but fall a little short. This talk covers why and how these fails happened and illustrate the forensic artifacts and the techniques used to analyze them.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 21
